⛏️ TreasureDig

A plot of land is divided into dig sites — some contain buried treasure, others contain worthless junk. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Study the clues or hints about where the treasure is buried.
  2. Click on a plot of land to dig there.
  3. If you hit treasure, you win that site's prize.
  4. Each site can only be dug once — choose carefully.
  5. Dig all sites to find all treasures (and junk) on the map.
